text.bundled-skills.mjs: names the skills Lantern bundles (the delegate and its complex variant among them), the skills each role reads in full, the ones among them a role may switch off, and the bundled skills a role shows as always on
text.bundled-skills.mjs gotcha: mirrors BUNDLE_SKILLS by hand; a test pins the two equal
text.check-skill-use.mjs: gate that fails a delegate transcript when a required skill was read partly or not at all; the required skills are the list of the chosen role (the delegate by default, or the orchestrator on its own session transcript) from the required-skills list; the brief is never judged; it exports the read finder the e2e harness reuses
text.check-skill-use.mjs gotcha: unlike the other linters it blocks the handover; an unresolved extra is skipped with a warning
text.check-skill-use.mjs < skills/lantern-del: gives the fixed skills of the role plus the slot extras that resolve, whose list the transcript is held to
text.delegate-kinds.mjs: names the agent types of the Sonnet, Opus and Fable delegates and their reviewers, and tells the kind of a delegate and of a model, and which reviewer type fits it
text.extension-skills.mjs: reads the global extensions config and the project's own file without ever failing on either, a damaged one named in a warning and treated as empty without touching the other, merges each slot's extras (global names first, then the project's, each once) and splits each slot's extras into the ones that resolve in the skill registry and warnings for the rest, including ones naming the always-on skills it dropped and the off-list names that cannot be switched off, and hands on each slot's off list
text.extension-skills.mjs gotcha: a damaged config becomes a warning and empty slots, never an exception
text.check-skill-use.mjs < skills/lantern-del: finds link and full-or-partial read events in Bash commands
text.cost-block.mjs: names the cost block marker and builds the Run cost content from the table
text.host.mjs: tells bitbucket from github and picks the remote
text.init-local.mjs: makes a fresh folder a git repository on main with a first commit
text.init-local.mjs gotcha: creates a repository: run it only from the orchestrator's preflight step
text.lint-reviewer.mjs: flags a code review a delegate dispatched to any agent type but its own reviewer (reviewer, or reviewer-complex for a Fable delegate), a reviewer type that was not found, a model passed on a reviewer spawn, and a delegate type that ran on another model family
text.lint-reviewer.mjs < skills/lantern-deleg: tells a Sonnet, Opus or Fable delegate apart, by agent type first, so the reviewer it must use is known
text.lint-reviewer.mjs gotcha: informational only: the orchestrator reports its count and never blocks the handover on it
text.lint-skill-reads.mjs: flags a skill a delegate linked with the configured skill linker and never read from disk afterwards, also inside piped or chained commands and for-loops over a literal list
text.lint-skill-reads.mjs < skills/lantern-de: splits each Bash command into segments, tagged when piped, to find links and full or partial reads
text.lint-skill-reads.mjs gotcha: informational only: the orchestrator reports its count and never blocks the handover on it
text.lint-transcript.mjs: flags chained, expanding or otherwise guard-unsafe Bash commands recorded in a delegate transcript, and a run of the configured skill linker without --skill
text.lint-transcript.mjs gotcha: informational only: the orchestrator reports its count and never blocks the handover on it
text.permissions.mjs: lists the git, skills-link, script and skill linker (list and link) permissions a delegate needs, plus the Edit and Write rules for every file the skills tell an agent to write (EDIT_TARGETS), and prints them as a settings.json snippet; also finds settings files that cannot be parsed or have the wrong permissions shape
text.permissions.mjs gotcha: deny patterns are matched by the harness, not enforced here; protocol.md still forbids force pushes
text.pr-append-cost.mjs: appends the run cost table to an open PR on either host through the host skill's description block command
text.pr-append-cost.mjs gotcha: reads no token: the host skill resolves the account from the environment or the running Lantern
text.pr-create.mjs: checks the commit identity and the branch name, then opens the PR through the host skill's create command
text.preflight.mjs: checks the host skill and its credentials check (and says where the account came from), target, commit identity (and where its e-mail came from: the Lantern profile, GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL, or a warning), skills (bundled, plus the configured extras, global and the project's) and permissions, and notes the optional skill linker path (an unusable one is only noted) before dispatch for Claude or Codex, and notes whether optional RTK is present; no remote means local mode, --local-only and delivery local skip publication checks, delivery push skips the host skill; --plan also needs the planning skills, loaded when it runs, and an approved, clean plan that is the one on the base
text.preflight.mjs > skills/lantern-plan/scri: asks it whether the named plan can be handed over and which items are next
text.preflight.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/: adds the resolving orchestrator-slot extras to the registry check and warns about the extras and a damaged config it skips
resolves the skill linker path only when it is configured, and prints nothing about it otherwise
text.preflight.mjs gotcha: chdirs into --repo-dir, yet the skill registry is still the session's own provider skill roots (.claude or .agents)
text.preflight.mjs = skills/lantern-delegate/: sets up a fresh folder under --init
text.preflight.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/: fails on missing permissions (commands and file edits, each named), names any settings file it cannot read, points at Lantern or the installer, and prints the snippet
reports RTK as an ok or note line, plus a hook warning, that never fails the gate
text.required-skills.mjs: lists the skills a role must read in full: its fixed skills minus any the user switched off, plus the host and planning skills for the orchestrator when asked, plus the extras of its slot that resolve, global ones then those of the project (the working directory's, a worktree's main checkout, or --project), without repeats; printed as one name per line for the delegate and the orchestrator, with a warning line for an extra it skips
text.required-skills.mjs gotcha: extras resolve against the cwd's .claude/skills, so run it after linking the skills in a worktree
text.preflight.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/: names the planning skills a --plan run needs besides the bundled ones
text.rtk-detect.mjs: probes a found rtk with --version, gain and an edition check and returns plain data: found, path, version, edition, hook, reason
text.rtk-detect.mjs gotcha: edition comes from an unverified guess (rtk pipeline); probes use a temp RTK_DB_PATH
text.rtk-detect.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate: settings files that set an rtk hook
path of the rtk to probe
text.rtk-hook.mjs: lists the Claude settings files, user and project, that contain an rtk hook claude entry, reading them only; none when any of them sets disableAllHooks
text.rtk-resolve.mjs: finds the rtk executable in home folders, the injected fixed folders, on PATH, then optionally through a login shell
text.skill-linker.mjs < skills/lantern-delega: words which cause made a linker path unusable
text.skill-linker.mjs: takes the skill linker script, or the repo folder holding exactly one such script, from SKILL_LINKER, the extensions config or else the folder SKILLS_REPO names, never by searching, checks the skills repo behind it has core, names the cause when a path is unusable, and tells whether a command word is that script by exact path or basename
text.skill-linker.mjs gotcha: none configured gives an empty result, not an error, and no command word then counts as the linker
text.split-command.mjs: splits a shell command into quote-aware segments of words, marking those that follow a pipe, and drops unquoted redirections, keeping the file of a < redirection
text.git-env.mjs: runs git with readable errors and reads the commit identity names from the environment or the project's .ai/.env, the fallback when the Lantern profile gives no e-mail
text.git-env.mjs gotcha: reads only GIT_COMMIT_NAME and GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL from .ai/.env, never a token
text.host-skill.mjs: finds the Lantern host skill of bitbucket or github and runs its command line as a subprocess, so credentials stay in that skill
text.host-skill.mjs gotcha: looks beside this skill first, then in the project's .claude/skills and .agents/skills and the home ones
text.lantern-account.mjs: asks the running Lantern, through the host skill's socket module, for the e-mail of the project's profile, giving nothing when Lantern or the account is missing
text.lantern-account.mjs gotcha: loads lantern-socket.mjs of the host skill at run time, so it works only where that skill is installed
text.extensions.mjs: reads and writes the per-user extensions config (~/.claude/lantern-extensions.json) and the project's own file (.claude/lantern-extensions.json, three slots only, atomic, refusing a symlinked folder or file): extra skills per delegate, orchestrator or reviewer slot and the built-in skills switched off per slot (global only); resolves a working directory to its project, sending a linked worktree to its main checkout; merges two lists first-list-first without repeats; refusing an unknown slot, a locked bundled skill, a non-folder name, a duplicate or a damaged file; a locked name found among the extras is dropped on read and on the next save, as is a locked or unknown name in the off list
text.extensions.mjs gotcha: mirrors the slots of src/shared/extension-slots.ts by hand; a test pins them equal
text.messages.json: The predefined texts of the delegate scripts, kept in the skill so it stays self-contained: the preflight sentences, the pull-request script's errors and warnings, the commit identity sentences, the delivery preference messages and the extensions config and project file warnings
text.messages.mjs: Reads a text from the skill's messages.json by dotted key and fills its named placeholders, returning the key when the text is missing
text.pr-create.mjs gotcha: refuses a branch that is not feat, fix, docs or chore plus a slug, before anything leaves the machine
text.pr-create.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/: runs the host skill's check for the login and its create for the PR
text.preferences.mjs: reads and writes the project's PR delivery choice (pr, push or local) in .claude/lantern-preferences.json, keeping every other key
text.preferences.mjs gotcha: refuses a damaged file instead of overwriting it, and any value that is not one of the three
text.preflight.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/: runs the host skill's check to learn whether the account can open a PR
tells whether the commit e-mail came from the profile or the env file
